newsitem.title: USA: Tucker Anthony eyes some ex-Dillon sales staffers.
newsitem.headline: Tucker Anthony eyes some ex-Dillon sales staffers.

text.p: Tucker Anthony Inc is in "very preliminary" talks with some former Dillon Read & Co muni professionals, but Tucker Anthony is not contemplating re-opening its muni institutional sales department, Tucker's head of fixed income said Wednesday.

"We have an institutional sales department, and we have people that actually do taxable business, and tax-free business already," Bob Cassinelli, senior vice president and director of fixed income, said. "We don't have a separate (municipal sales) department, it's integrated into our institutional sales department."
Dillon Read announced on June 12 that it would exit the municipal bond business effective June 20.
"There's a whole department that's been let go over there, we're mostly interested in the sales people," Cassinelli said.
Tucker shut its muni institutional sales department in early 1996, he said.
If Tucker Anthony adds anyone from Dillon Read, "it would be just institutional sales people that happen to do tax-exempt business as opposed to taxable," Cassinelli said.

"I'm trying to give you the definite impression that we are not going back into the institutional municipal business. We are in it right now," Cassinelli said. "We have 450 brokers in this firm that are talking to a lot of institutions, and we have eight municipal traders. We are trying to manage it very carefully, without opening another department and making a big fanfare."
Tucker Anthony's home office is in Boston, Mass.
